root_cause: Dashboard V2 compared raw cumulative actor NAV from 2020 against a 2026 YTD SOXLBacktest reference, which made nav_delta_vs_baseline unreadable and hid model differences.
changes: Comparison payload now keeps raw strategy_nav but adds strategy_nav_rebased and computes nav_delta_vs_baseline from the common-window start.
The frontend NAV chart rebases each visible model line to the visible window start.
Data Status now shows default model replay_end dates directly.
The main K-line keeps the selected model position overlay in a separate hidden-scale band and exposes OHLC in the inspector.
The first viewport now shows Position and Rebased NAV comparison charts below the K-line.
verification: cd web/dashboard-v2 && npm test && npm run build
